!tracking.name: Nyzul Status
!tracking.show_when: session.nyzul and (session.nyzul.current_floor or (session.nyzul.time_remaining_until and session.nyzul.time_remaining_until > time))
format: session.nyzul.time_remaining_until and session.nyzul.time_remaining_until > time and format('%s%s', session.nyzul.current_floor and ' • ' or '', color_number(format('%d:%02d', (max(0, session.nyzul.time_remaining_until - time) + 0.999) / 60, (max(0, session.nyzul.time_remaining_until - time) + 0.999) % 60))) or ''
